svg.title: Workflow execution: pass rate and latency
svg.desc: AFlow: single-conversation pass rate 90.5% versus stateless calls 86.8%; latency 53.53 versus 54.98 seconds. OneFlow: 87.4% versus 87.0%; latency 4.83 versus 4.31 seconds. Single-conversation execution is slightly slower for OneFlow. Qwen3 8B on HumanEval; vLLM, 16k context, three-run means. Table 4 reports no uncertainty intervals. Compare execution methods within each workflow. Token budgets are not matched; latency and pass rate have separate axes.
